detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

P-21 (Adamantane)

Chemical Information:
  • Compound Type: Synthetic peptide research compound
  • Peptide Length: Short peptide
  • Chemical Modification: Adamantane conjugation
  • Form: Lyophilized solid

Note: P-21 (Adamantane) represents a chemically modified peptide incorporating an adamantane moiety. Exact molecular characteristics, including molecular weight and elemental composition, are confirmed on a lot-specific basis in the accompanying Certificate of Analysis.

Product Description:

P-21 (Adamantane) is a synthetic peptide research compound that incorporates an adamantane structural modification, a hydrophobic moiety commonly used in chemical research to alter physicochemical properties of peptide sequences. The compound is produced via controlled synthesis and supplied as a lyophilized powder for laboratory use.

This product is intended exclusively for controlled in-vitro research applications conducted by qualified professionals and is not formulated for clinical, diagnostic, or therapeutic use.

Research Applications:
  • In-vitro evaluation of chemically modified peptide analogs in biochemical assay systems
  • Comparative analysis of peptide conjugates incorporating hydrophobic structural groups
  • Stability and degradation profiling of modified peptide sequences
  • Analytical method development involving non-standard peptide conjugates
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at −20 °C until use
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2–8 °C and use promptly
  • Handle using appropriate aseptic laboratory techniques
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white to off-white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory buffers
Compliance Notice:

P-21 (Adamantane) is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
